pages._note: Campaign list as a declarative type:index page (marketing-campaigns), read-only. Create and edit go to CampaignFormView instead of the declarative dialog, and showAdd / showFormDialog / showEditAction are therefore off: a campaign written through OpenRegister's object API carries whatever utmCampaign the browser sent and stores a source outside the tenant's vocabulary without complaint. Minting the campaign value once, freezing it across a rename, and refusing an unknown source or medium live in CampaignService, which only POST and PATCH /api/campaigns reach. The report is not reachable from here either: it is a card on the Reports page (ADR-112).
pages.title: Campaigns

pages._note: Campaign create and edit as a thin route wrapper around CampaignFormView (marketing-campaigns), matching the SegmentNew / TemplateNew / BlastNew convention. Custom rather than a declarative form: the create path mints the campaign value from the name and freezes it, and it refuses a source or medium outside the tenant's app-config vocabulary, which no declarative form primitive expresses. Missing primitive: a form whose enum options come from app config rather than from the schema.

pages._note: Campaign record as a declarative type:detail page (ADR-062 grid). The campaign's own fields auto-render in the details widget. The landing page block is a bodyWidgets section rather than a declarative widget for two reasons: it carries an ACTION that dispatches a cross-app event portaliq answers, which no declarative action expresses, and it must surface portaliq's own typed error code verbatim, which a generic write dialog would collapse into a save failure. Its props carry @objectId, the only token that resolves on a detail page.
pages.title: Campaign

pages._note: The campaign report (marketing-campaigns, ADR-112). Reached as a card on the Reports page and never as a menu entry of its own. Custom because the page renders ONE aggregate response that joins blasts, touchpoints, leads and shillinq invoices across four schemas, with three attribution models already computed in it; no declarative index or dashboard primitive expresses that, and building it from per-object reads is the fan-out pipelinq#1781 removed from the blast performance page. Missing primitive: an aggregation-backed report page.
